input: Get a professional headshot taken for LinkedIn

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Whether they use a professional photographer, a friend with a good camera, or a smartphone self-setup completely changes the plan, cost, and preparation steps.
Budget determines whether professional studio photography, a freelance photographer, or a DIY approach is realistic.
Knowing the desired timeline affects whether they need to book immediately and how much prep time they have for outfit, grooming, etc.
The desired look and feel (formal corporate vs. approachable creative) shapes location, outfit, background color, and posing direction.
Whether they only need one final image or want a variety of shots and outfits changes the session length and editing requirements.
Their industry and role influence the expected dress code, formality level, and what a 'professional' headshot actually means for them.
Knowing whether they need the final image retouched and delivered digitally, printed, or in a specific file format defines what 'done' looks like.

gold.taskTitle: Get a professional LinkedIn headshot taken
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to get a professional headshot photograph taken specifically for use on their LinkedIn profile.

questions.title: Will you hire a photographer or do it yourself?
questions.description: Determine whether the user plans to book a professional studio/freelance photographer, use a friend, or set up a DIY shoot.

questions.title: What is your budget for this headshot?
questions.description: Establish a budget range to narrow down photographer tiers, studio options, or DIY equipment needs.

questions.title: When do you need the final photo ready?
questions.description: Identify the deadline or desired date so booking and preparation steps can be sequenced correctly.

questions.title: What look are you going for — formal, approachable, or creative?
questions.description: Understand the desired tone and aesthetic to guide outfit, background, and posing choices.

questions.title: Do you need one final shot or multiple looks?
questions.description: Clarify whether a single polished image is sufficient or if they want variety across outfits or backgrounds.

questions.title: What industry and role is this headshot for?
questions.description: Identify the professional field and seniority level to calibrate the expected formality and style of the photo.

questions.title: Do you need retouching and a specific file format delivered?
questions.description: Determine what a completed, usable deliverable looks like — retouched digital file, specific resolution, print copies, etc.
